title: SCOOP: Vikrant Massey joins Ajay Devgn’s Chauhaan; to play a layered grey character
summary: Vikrant Massey has reportedly been cast in Ajay Devgn’s upcoming action thriller Chauhaan, produced by Jio Studios and Aanand L Rai. Sources say Massey will play a layered grey character opposite Devgn. Filming is expected to begin late 2026 with a Gandhi Jayanti 2027 release planned.
content:
Ajay Devgn, Jio Studios and Aanand L Rai's collaboration on Chauhaan has become one of the most talked-about projects of the year. The announcement video generated widespread reaction and placed the film squarely in Gen-Z conversations.

According to Bollywood Hungama sources, Aanand L Rai has roped in Vikrant Massey to play a key role in the Ajay Devgn-led action thriller inspired by true events. "Vikrant Massey will be seen like never before in this action thriller inspired by true events. He plays a layered grey character, and his tashan with Ajay Devgn will be among the major highlights of Chauhaan," a source told Bollywood Hungama.

Sources close to the production say Massey was blown away by the script and gave an instant yes to the part. Insiders add that the dynamic between Ajay Devgn and Vikrant Massey will read as two powerhouses from different generations sharing the screen, promising a compelling clash of styles and presence.

Pre-production is reportedly in full swing. The production plans to take the film on floors in the last quarter of 2026, with a target release around Gandhi Jayanti 2027. Industry chatter is already dubbing the project a potential "Dhurandhar of 2027," with expectations high for both box-office performance and critical attention.

Chauhaan is being presented as an action thriller grounded in events that inspired the screenplay, with producers and creative teams aiming for a taut, gritty tone. Casting additions like Massey suggest the film will balance star power with layered supporting performances to build dramatic intensity.

Fans of both actors and followers of Hindi cinema will be watching casting and production updates closely as the project moves toward principal photography. Further casting announcements and production details are expected in the coming months.
